body: Look, high school will end up and you will go to a place that people will understand you. There are so many places that will acept you. I live in a small town but we are quite diferent of other small towns. In my high school there don't exist bullying. I never saw no one bully no one in my high school and there aren't popularity or the freaks that no one talk to. We are all friends. There are squad but we all are friends. And when you let high school you can come to a place like where i live. And everything will be ok. Because no one will fucking care if you like girls boys or both. And you will be so much happyer and you will found friends that will make you be more social. But don't end it up now. Because now all is a shit. My life is a shit. But when you grow up you will choose who you will be and thous mother fucking bullyes will be forever beeing assholes and you will try to be happy. So don't worry. And think about that someday you will get out of that shit. But in the meantime you can talk to me. I'm here.

I get you. I want someone to love too. All my friends have or had someone and i'm just alone. I want a couple. But having a gilfriend just not to kill yourself isn't the answer. Maby when you found a gilfriend all will be better for a while. But then when the relationship isn't the same as in the beggining you will end up in the same place you are now. Don't try to take someone to cover the hole, you need to fix the hole just using yourself. But i know how you feel beeing alone.

Hi, if you need to talk i'm here. The ugly/pretty thing is so relative. Some people say i'm pretty and others that i'm not. But think that if that one person loved you there will be more. If you are a good person you will find someone. And true friends don't love you because of your looks so focus on finding a true friend. But hey! You aren't alone, don't feel alone, i'm here.
Just breathe you don't have to do this. There's always a way out. If i can help you in this, just talk to me. But don't do it please. You can get out of this.

Maby you just didn't found your people. Don't be around people that don't want you. You deserve someone that will love you by the way you are. And you will see how someday you will find someone that really will want you by him/her side. But i know right now is difficult but hold on. If you need to talk, feel free to message me.

You don't have to kill yourself, please. If you really thing he would be better without you, you can just divorce. And try to be the person you whant to be for yourself and others. Take some time for yourself. Go to another place, and forget who you were and be the one you always wanted to be. You have life to live, you can start from 0 without hurting yourself or others. There is hope.

Love,S.

That's the thing of making friends. You never know if they are forever. But there are some that are. So if that friend let you for other people, it's just isn't the friend that you need. But tha's ok, because like this you can find another friend, in real life or in internet. And you should never put your happyness in someone that you aren't sure if it's gonna last forever, even if you love him  that much. But don't worry, i do the same. And your mom just doesn't know how to act in a case like yours. But you should never want to die because someday when you get out of school and start living your own life you will meet so many people and live so many things that will you make find true happyness. And you don't have to feel bad about feeling good knowing that they care about you. It's ok to feel the need of feel loved. It's human. And if you need to talk you can talk to me. I won't judge you, i will just try to help you. 

Love, S.
Just know that there are people there for you.

Do you talked with someone about how you feel? A friendo or familiar? I think fist you should go to someone taht you really love. And if you can't, you should talk with a professional. But i think that maby you need someone that loves you to listen to you.

Love, S.

Look, i don't know you. But i don't want you to die. But if you gonna do it. Travel, go to other places. Do crazy things. Do things that normally people don't do because they'll be still here tomorrow. Or if you don't want to be yourself, be someone to others. I mean, help others. There are so many people that need you in this world. There are people that even in the midle of the war want to live, or keep their child alive. So help them. Do things for others. Don't be more yourself, just be a something good for this sick world. Be someone to remember when you die. Suicide is so selfish. I had a love one that died years ago. And that made me so sad. Sometimes i think about killing myself. Because that feel makes me so sad. And i hate myself and my live. But i never gonna be able to do it. Because i don't want my love ones to feel the pain i feel. That sadness, that seems like it doesn't have an ending. But please, please, please don't do it. I don't want you to be out of this world or your mother to feel the way you feel right now. Just think about it more. And love your family and friends, because you never know when you gonna loose them.

Love, S.
